description: Search GLPI items with criteria. itemtype: Ticket, User, Change, Problem, Computer, etc. Each criterion is {field, searchtype, value, link}: field = search option ID, searchtype = contains | equals | notequals | lessthan | morethan | under, link = AND | OR (omit on the first). Rows come keyed by the search option names in the GLPI user's language ('Título', 'ID', 'Status'...); coded columns (status, priority, urgency, impact, type, approval) hold the GLPI label and the code sits beside it as '<name> (id)' (e.g. 'Status': 'Solucionado', 'Status (id)': 5). named_columns=false returns the raw search keyed by option ID ('1', '2'...). Use glpi_list_search_options to discover the option IDs for criteria, forcedisplay and sort.

criteria.description: Array of {field, searchtype, value, link}; a group is {link, criteria: [...]} (e.g. requester OR technician)

fields.description: Field set: 'essential' (default, trims internal GLPI fields) or 'all'

forcedisplay.description: Search option IDs to add as columns

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'markdown' (a table for listings, key/value lines for one item; returned in both the text and the structured result)

itemtype.description: Item type, e.g. Ticket, User, Change, Problem

named_columns.description: Key each row by search option name, coded values labelled (default true); false = raw, by numeric option ID

sort.description: Search option ID to sort by (e.g. 19 = last update on Ticket)

name: glpi_search

format.description: 'markdown' when data holds the markdown rendering

note.description: Pagination hint: how to fetch the next page

total.description: Total matching items in GLPI (all pages)

title: Search items
